1.title: Real NASA SPHEREx snapshots
1.body: Each frame stacks the SPHEREx exposures of one visit, aligned onto the same sky grid. Visits are months apart.

2.title: Press ▶ to blink
2.body: Use ▶, the ⏮ ⏭ buttons or the slider to flip between visits. Distant stars stay still; nearby objects shift.

3.title: Something jumping? Try Difference
3.body: Difference subtracts the first visit from the last. A moving object leaves a dark and a bright spot inside the rings.

4.title: Spotted something interesting?
4.body: Click "I found something!" to save coordinates and share your candidate with the community.
